text:
maya: kicking off bring-up for cerulean-lite-v2 (512d) on the wiki+faq corpus. goal: sanity on recall@1/5/10 + cluster purity before canary. running 10k sample with sharded indexing.
oliver: baseline for comparison?
maya: using beacon-base-v2 (768d) and also a lite-baseline-512 checkpoint we tuned earlier. comparing raw dot vs cosine.
noah: quantization plan? int8 + per-channel int6 probe. int6 is experimental on ONNX path.
sara: note: int6 uses asymmetric scale, watch centroid skew.
maya: first 10k int8 (rawdot, ivf) quick stats:
```
Recall@1: cerulean 0.65 | lite-baseline 0.70 | beacon 0.75
Recall@5: 0.84 | 0.87 | 0.90
Recall@10: 0.91 | 0.93 | 0.95
KMeans purity (k=100): cerulean 0.58 | lite-baseline 0.61
Median intra-cluster cosine: 0.67 | 0.71
```
noah: @1 gap larger than I expected. curious about short-query slice and multilingual chunk.
maya: sampling top failures for short queries: (query -> expected / top1)
- "reset password" -> expected "account recovery" / got "security settings"
- "shipping cost" -> expected "rates" / got "delivery times"
- "how to cancel" -> expected "subscription cancel" / got "billing dispute"
these are close but specificity off.
oliver: try l2 norm + cosine metric. also test a small prompt augmentation: prefix short queries with "question:" at embed time to see if that nudges specificity.
sara: running cosine job with normalization and augmented short-query promptset (batchsize 128). indexing ivf_flat, nlist=4096.
evalbot: queued eval job job_2026_03_22_cerulean_01; sample=10k; configs=[cerulean-int8-cosine-aug, cerulean-int6-cosine, lite-baseline-int8]. ETA ~ 12m.
noah: while that runs, request UMAP for the ambiguous clusters and compute centroid drift vs lite-baseline. also check density ratio for clusters with high impurity.
maya: cosine+norm results in:
```
Recall@1: 0.69
Recall@5: 0.86
Recall@10: 0.93
KMeans purity: 0.62
Median intra-cluster cosine: 0.70
Centroid drift (vs baseline): 0.05
```
maya: short-query failures reduced; example: "reset password" now returns "account recovery" top1. augmentation helped.
oliver: great. int6 run?
sara: int6-perchannel run is noisy: Recall@1 0.60, @5 0.82. UMAP shows compression along the intent axis for short queries.
noah: handwritten calibration might help int6 but probably not worth it for canary. keep int6 for low-cost offline indices.
maya: decision: promote cerulean-int8-cosine-aug to staging canary at 5% with fallback to lite-baseline on recall@1 drop >0.03. add short-query promptset monitor and cluster purity monitor (threshold purity <0.55 alert).
oliver: +1. please include p50/p95 latency with microbatch=32 in the rollout PR.
sara: infra note: will reserve an extra shard to reduce cold-start variance during canary.
evalbot: monitoring hooks created: monitor_id=mon_cerulean_shortq_20260322; alert if recall@1 delta <= -0.03 for 1h.
maya: will open PR with rollout policy and promptset. thanks team.
oliver: thanks, nice turnaround.
maya: closing thread after PR. :rocket:
